messages.content:
Risk: Compromised confidential information
Description: The AI system, including its supporting compute infrastructure, may serve as an attack vector for intrusion into cyber-physical or cloud environments, or enable exfiltration of secrets.
Concern: None
Policy: Insider Threat & Cybersecurity

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#TradeSecretDisclosure: Trade Secret Disclosure — Unauthorized revelation of confidential business information such as formulas, processes, customer lists, or proprietary methods that provide competitive advantage. [found by 4/9 queries]
  Siblings: Plagiarism, Trademark Violation, Copyright Infringement
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#EmploymentDataExposure: Employment Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of employment information including compensation, performance evaluations, or workplace records that individuals expect to remain confidential. [found by 4/9 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure: Financial Data Exposure — Disclosure of personal financial information including account numbers, credit scores, or transaction histories without authorization. [found by 4/9 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories. [found by 4/9 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 4/9 queries]

axes.rationale: This class directly addresses the risk of confidential information (trade secrets) being compromised, aligning with the risk description.
The risk mentions exfiltration of secrets, which could include financial data. This class captures that aspect.
